scheme_name: Garima Greh Shelter Homes For Transgender Persons
other_conditions: Must have a certificate issued through the National Portal for Transgender Persons (or obtain one by registering on the portal)
Must be an abandoned transgender person
Must not be engaged in sex work or beggary
Must be unemployed and not engaged in productive commercial activities
Must register by completing the admission form (Annexure 2) and personal affidavit (Annexure 3)
benefits_summary: Eligible transgender persons receive shelter along with food, medical care and recreational facilities.
documents_required: Certificate issued through the National Portal for Transgender Persons
